notes.title: Control Mapping Update
notes.content:
Added some quality-of-life elements to the game:

Gameplay Additions:

 Added a new control mapping menu to the controls section of the pause menus, allowing you to change controls for the vehicle.
 Added a new Radio function to allow you to switch radio tracks when driving.
 Added a camera shake slider to change the intensity of the camera shake while driving.
 Added a spotlight in Midnight City near the warehouse area in the shortcut, for slightly better visibility of the shortcut.

notes.title: Map Creator Additions Update
notes.content:
This update will be a combination of minimap adjustments and map additions! Below are the notable changes:

Minimap Adjustments

 Icons now scale to a larger size for better visibility.
 Icons will fade out if they are behind the player, preventing UI clutter.
 The next checkpoint icon is brightened slightly for easier detection.


Map Creator – Race Additions

Race Creator Mechanic Use:

When placing race checkpoints, the first placed object becomes the starting/discovery point. Every subsequent point becomes a checkpoint for the race. Prizes and difficulty levels (e.g., time constraints or drift score requirements) will be auto-generated based on the race length—specifically how many checkpoints exist and which stages you have unlocked. When you exit the creator menu, the race is finalized and added to the map.


 Added a creation option for Time Trials
 Added a creation option for Drift Events
 Added a creation option for Sprint Events
 Added a lighting menu to adjust the map’s daytime lighting

notes.title: Minimap Icons Update
notes.content:
Made some changes to the minimap for better navigation:



Minimap

Shop, event, and checkpoint icons now appear along the edges of the minimap when they’re off-screen.
When a checkpoint is currently active in a race, the next checkpoint now has its own indicator.


Lighting

Lights/flares no longer turn on in Newport (since it’s daytime), but their emission remains visible.


Bug Fix

In a late-stage Speed Capture race in Neolectric, the race was incorrectly labeled “Endpoint.” This has now been fixed.

notes.title: Map Creator Update
notes.content:
New addition to the game which is the map creator! Inside the mods menu, you'll now have an option to go to create a map. The map creator is currently just for driving around in, but gives you tools to create roads, buildings, props and such. You'll be able to upload / download maps on mod.io as well! Maps can be accessed in the garage menu.



New Additions:


 Map creator, build your own maps and drive in them!
 Download and upload maps from mod.io


Additional Changes:


 Adjusted the gear ratio on a few vehicles.
 Can change how close your view is via dpad up on controller or scrollwheel up on mouse, ranging from close, mid and far.

notes.title: Settings Update (01/24/2025)
notes.content:
Added a couple new settings that can be adjusted in menus:


New Settings:


 Added a new mph setting that toggles on/off the gauge reader to read the speed in mph or kph.
 Added a new difficulty slider that enhances or downgrades the enemy AI vehicles. 


Other Changes:


 Fixed an issue in the end game stage mirror race of Newport, should now end on the last checkpoint.
 Adjusted the mall in Hood Rock, making adjustments to some lighting and adding a few things.
 Added a gear reader in the gauge that tells you what gear the car is in.

notes.title: Settings Adjustments
notes.content:
Made some settings adjustments to the game, added manual shifting through the new 'automatic shifting' variable, pause menu has been redone a bit to add more buttons. Changes will be listed below:

New Settings:


 Added an 'automatic shifting' variable in settings, if toggled off then manual shifting will be available in the game.


Pause Menu:


 Changed the leave button function to exit to the menu rather than go to the garage.
 Added a button specifically for going back to the garage.
 Added graphics menu to the pause menu, adjustments can be made during gameplay now.
 Added gameplay menu to the pause menu, adjustments can be made but level will need to be reloaded to see changes in effect.

notes.title: Drift Rework Update
notes.content:
Drifting mechanic has been reworked as a whole. More changes have been made as well via city additions and some AI adjustments. Will list out changes below:



Drifting Mechanic changes:


 Vehicle physics have been adjusted when drifting, aimed at making drifts more fluid.
 Scoring has been adjusted, points are less forgiving for burning out now but are more forgiving for wider drifts.
 Camera has a slower rotational effect when following the vehicle in drift modes.
 There is now an added multiplier when wider drifts are made, multiplier will change color to orange when in effect.
 Smoke effects become larger when in drift mode




Other changes:


 AI has been adjusted to be faster in highway races, some races have been adjusted with modified AI racing lines.
 Neolectric city additions, new buildings have been added in place of some construction areas near the warehouse area. Some buildings have been adjusted and/or modified as well in other areas.
 Fixed issue where drift event UI would appear in photo mode.

notes.title: Map Additions - v1.03
notes.content:
Updated all maps with visual features, as well as adjusted some gameplay elements. Changes will be listed below:



City Changes:

- Hood Rock

 Added an airport off to the side in one section of the city, airplane flies over city every once in a while

- Midnight City

 Added a train to the elevated train tracks in the warehouse area, also added a small shortcut

- Neolectric:

 Added some scenery items, some fountains and some building changes

- Newport:

 Added some scenery items, some fountains and trees




Other Changes:

[olist]
 Added an extra arrow to the checkpoint indicator on the minimap when in a race, giving a more clear indication on which direction the next checkpoint will be.
 Adjusted the braking system a bit more, now there is a bigger gap between low tier brakes and high tier brakes (higher brakes are more effective).
[/olist]

notes.title: Quick patch - handling adjustments
notes.content: Adjusted handling a bit, braking has more power now and turning has been adjusted slightly

notes.title: Demo Update - Intro Sequence
notes.content: Demo has now been updated with a new intro sequence! This includes some new cinematics that walk you through joining the league, and also includes an end game vehicle in the introduction in a later map, being Hood Rock. The goal being to give the user a better idea of what the later end game content will be, along with giving some more context to the story of you joining the league. Feel free to check it out!
